_doc: M0a 冻结后新增裸 import 的唯一合法通道(设计 v0.2 §5 + considered amendment 6c612df5+5d013865 + amendment#2 provision-writer 2026-07-23 NWT 快裁 GREEN)。七字段全必填: id/family/form/path/capability/justification/review_ref。capability ∈ {db-readonly, test-fixture, m0c-controlled-relay-endpoint, m0c1-provision-writer}。test-fixture 三静态限制全过可用 review_ref='self-serve:readonly-test'; db-readonly 必须人审锚(频道 txid / ledger)。relay-manager 族只经窄 capability m0c-controlled-relay-endpoint 放行受控 funnel(白名单 CONTROLLED_FUNNEL_ALLOWLIST shrink-only + content_digest[该文件批准时内容 sha256 hex]TOCTOU 防御 + NWT diff 审 load-bearing, NWT 4 约束); 其余 relay-manager import 一律硬拒走仓储层/API。m0c1-provision-writer=M0a 最敏感 capability(grant 铸造权威): 仅 PROVISION_WRITER_ALLOWLIST 单文件 shrink-only(扩张 NWT 审+Owner 知情硬锁) + content_digest 核心防护(脚本任何改动失配即重审, 防批准后改写别处/铸假 grant) + writer 静态负面检查(禁 relay-manager/网络面, 离线纯 DB 写)。

entries.justification: M0c-1 批B operator 结算专道 = relay.js:1726 零鉴权裸透传端点收敛 A 方案的 money-path 出口(受控 funnel, 非裸透传): POST /api/operator/settle-command 三层 auth(env 开关 ADMIN_OPERATOR_SETTLE_ENABLED 默认 off + checkAdminSecretTier(ADMIN_SECRET_OPERATOR_SETTLE 独立 operator 密钥, 非共享 ingest secret) + IP allowlist) + 命令白名单两档 fail-closed(covenant-specific 同档/transfer 额外 ADMIN_SECRET_OPERATOR_TRANSFER 独立 header tier/ecdsa_sign 剔除) + origin=operator。设计稿 docs/2026-07-23-m0c-1-operator-settle-lane-design.md v0.2 (Bettor 方向审 GREEN+NWT 红队 GREEN-with-2-note 复核闭)。

机制A HTTP能力网关custodial_transfer受控funnel(非裸透传): origin='app'网关强制覆写(app请求体任何origin声明被丢弃)+intent_type路由锁死(每路由绑死一个intent_type拒不匹配)+签名验证MUST+grant吊销/有效期/amount cap早拒验(cheap-to-expensive, 无效签名/超额不触发privkey解密)+default-off feature-flag(ADMIN_CAPABILITY_GATEWAY_ENABLED未设恒503, 与relay armed状态解耦)+privkeyHex网关自己查库派生非body输入(verify-value-source)+Path B围栏§2.7 checkRelayArmed(转发前查relay armed状态, origin='internal'非'app', fail-closed三路径全拒, cheap-to-expensive延伸置于AES解密前)+Path B围栏§2.4限流(pilot_rate_limit_log, keyed by grant_id, 3笔/60秒, 超限不计数防自我放大, 自清理)+§2.1 gateway早拒白名单(PILOT_WALLET_ADDRESSES, 空Set=default-deny, non-authoritative早拒层独立于relay侧source_scope权威层)。【2026-07-24 更新, claim==code恢复批次】Codex MSG-120外审抓到围栏设计声称的②限流③白名单此前只停在设计文档从未落码(over-claim事故), Bettor全员claim-to-code复查后重新派工, 本次补齐真代码+隔离测试7/7 PASS+既有回归26/2零新增+lint 0 errors。设计稿docs/2026-07-23-m0c-1-mechanism-a-http-capability-gateway-design.md §3.3/§3.3a + docs/2026-07-23-m0c-1-path-b-pilot-containment-design.md §2.1/§2.4/§2.7。NWT claim-to-code扫描核实②③: 限流表实存在+checkRateLimit实被调用+逻辑正确(fail-closed/超限不记录/自清理/位置对)+白名单PILOT_WALLET_ADDRESSES实存在+空Set实default-deny。

M0c-1 app provision operator 离线签发脚本(6e608b7e)= 全仓唯一 grant registry 写入方(M1-5 静态可枚举, NWT app provision GREEN 判据③实核: 零 HTTP/fetch/listen/IPC/sendCommand + privkey 只打印不落盘 + 直写 m0c1_app_grants 表 = 场景A结构不可达的实现方式)。裸 better-sqlite3 import 是其直写 DB 本意, 触 R-M0A-BARE-IMPORT-DIFF 是规则没 writer 档非 provision 错(NWT 快裁定性)。writer 档=grant 铸造权威最敏感: content_digest 锚 6e608b7e 版, 任何改动失配即重审。【2026-07-23 更新】J1 加 --source CLI 参数(Path B pilot 围栏 §2.1, source_scope 字段签发支持)——三处纯字段透传(usage 注释+row 对象+INSERT 语句), 跟既有 --payee/--market/--branch 完全同构, 零新逻辑分支/零 relay-manager import/零网络面, 不触及 provision-writer 静态负面检查任何一条。NWT diff 审 GREEN(跨节点用临时 docs 文件 60065f5e 传递, 场景 A 结构不可达属性不变)。content_digest 锚更新为本次改动后版本。
